quote: Motor vehicles being driven upon any highway outside of a business district in a caravan or motorcade, whether or not towing other vehicles, shall be operated to allow sufficient space between each such vehicle or combination of vehicles so as to enable any other vehicle or combination of vehicles to enter and occupy such space without danger.

activation.condition: Qualifying motor vehicles are driven on a highway outside a business district as a caravan or motorcade, whether towing or not.

obligation.description: Operate with sufficient space between each group vehicle or combination for any other vehicle or combination to enter and occupy without danger.

timing.description: Observe continuous original group movement and a distinct outsider entry opportunity over 30 seconds.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure each group body clear gap and actual independent entry occupancy; legal sufficiency remains for review.
Review actual participant motion, collision history, visibility and outsider occupancy; no numeric danger cutoff is supplied.
Use independently sourced participant relationship and purpose, not synchronized motion alone.
Review source-specific legal region classification and frontage; road appearance is insufficient.
